_about: Nine replication questions on three one-page papers. Each question is run under five conditions (see agent_lab.py CONDITIONS) = 45 scenarios. Ground truth is computed at run time by reference.py from the same data files; it is never copied into the agent's workspace.

questions.ask: the crossover penalty k* between OpenAI o4-mini and gpt-5-thinking-mini, as a decimal number of points per wrong answer
the score of OpenAI o4-mini under the Konkur rule (t = 0.25), in points per 100 questions
score(gpt-5-thinking-mini) minus score(OpenAI o4-mini) at confidence target t = 0.75, in points per 100 questions
the risk of model A on all ten questions, in percent
the score(k = 3) of model B on all ten questions, in points per question
the coverage of model A on the Persian (language = fa) questions only, in percent
the calibrated answerer's score at k = 3, in points per question
the overconfident answerer's coverage at k = 1, in percent
the overconfident answerer's score at k = 9, in points per question
